AIKIDO_CLIENT_ID.description: Aikido OAuth2 client id prefixed 'AIK_CLIENT_'. Minted at Aikido admin -> Settings -> API Keys. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

AIKIDO_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Aikido OAuth2 client secret prefixed 'AIK_SECRET_' paired with AIKIDO_CLIENT_ID. Exchanged at /api/oauth/token for a short-lived Bearer on each run. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

AIKIDO_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'issues,domains'. Valid: issues (per-file/per-line findings -> vulns tagged with affected_file + CVE + CWE), repositories (monitored code repos -> hosts), cloud (cloud accounts -> hosts), domains (Aikido attack-surface domains + subdomains -> hosts, includes each domain's app.aikido.dev link as a URL ref).

AIKIDO_ISSUE_TYPE.description: Restrict issues to one type. Valid: sast | iac | secret | open_source | cloud | container | mobile | dast | surface_monitoring | scm_security | leaked_secret. Omit for all types.

AIKIDO_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

AIKIDO_SEVERITY_MIN.description: Client-side severity floor for open issues. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: aikido
title: Aikido
description: Aikido continuous AppSec / cloud posture / attack surface import. OAuth2 client credentials (AIK_CLIENT_ + AIK_SECRET_) sent as HTTP Basic to /api/oauth/token, walks the public REST API (default https://app.aikido.dev/api/public/v1/): issues (via /issues/export — per-file, per-line, one row per affected occurrence) become Faraday vulnerabilities tagged '[AGENT]' with the affected file + line surfaced in the title, CVE + CWE cross-refs, and bucketed under the right asset (code_repo_name / domain_name / cloud_name / container_repo_name); code repos, cloud accounts, and attack-surface domains + subdomains become Faraday hosts tagged 'agent:aikido:*-inventory'. Domains mode includes the app.aikido.dev/domain/<id> deep link as a URL ref so operators can jump back to the Aikido UI. Set AIKIDO_ISSUE_TYPE=sast|iac|secret|open_source|cloud|container|mobile|dast|surface_monitoring|scm_security|leaked_secret to scope findings. Severity is normalised from Aikido's mixed enum/CVSS-score inputs into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; AIKIDO_SEVERITY_MIN drops rows below the floor. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Pagination via page/per_page; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
